definitions.explanation: A legal term for a serious failure of care that goes well beyond ordinary {過失|かしつ} (ordinary negligence). Used in civil and criminal law to denote a degree of carelessness so extreme that it borders on intent. Often the threshold above which liability cannot be disclaimed by contract.

examples.japanese: {重過失|じゅうかしつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{認|みと}められた→認める：02429_mitomeru⟧。

{重過失|じゅうかしつ}⟦による→による：28349_niyoru⟧⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{保険|ほけん}→保険：01509_hoken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{適用|てきよう}されない→適用する：21739_tekiyousuru⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Accidents caused by gross negligence may not be covered by insurance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{裁判所|さいばんしょ}→裁判所：09665_saibansho⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{安全|あんぜん}→安全：01131_anzen⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}→確認：00158_kakunin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{怠|おこた}った→怠る：03936_okotaru⟧⟦{運転手|うんてんしゅ}→運転手：01333_untenshu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{重過失|じゅうかしつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{判断|はんだん}した→判断する：06062_handansuru⟧。
examples.english: The court determined that the driver, who neglected to check for safety, was guilty of gross negligence.

notes:
Compound of {重|じゅう} (heavy, grave) + ⟦{過失|かしつ}→過失：00194_kashitsu⟧ (negligence). A specialized legal term distinguishing extreme carelessness from ordinary negligence; the boundary matters because liability disclaimers and certain insurance coverages do not apply in cases of {重過失|じゅうかしつ}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {重過失|じゅうかしつ}{致死|ちし}: gross negligence resulting in death (a criminal charge)
- {重過失|じゅうかしつ}⟦{致傷|ちしょう}→致傷：28482_chishou⟧: gross negligence resulting in injury
- {重過失|じゅうかしつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{認|みと}められる→認める：02429_mitomeru⟧: to be found guilty of gross negligence

SIMILAR / RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{過失|かしつ}→過失：00194_kashitsu⟧: (ordinary) negligence — the broader, baseline level of carelessness
- {軽過失|けいかしつ}: slight negligence — the opposite end of the spectrum
- ⟦{故意|こい}→故意：16844_koi⟧: intent; willfulness — distinguished from negligence; intentional wrongdoing is a separate category
